_note: Terrain tiles. create_tiles_pro is the right tool here, not
create_image_pixflux: pixflux composes SCENES, and asking it for a flat
top-down texture produced a hills tile with a sky and a horizon line.
This tool draws real tiles, so they are seamless and have no perspective.
One call returns 16 variations across the four numbered terrains. The
chosen indices are recorded in `outs` below so the selection is
reproducible: re-running with this seed yields the same 16, and these
four are the ones wired into the manifest.
`palette: false` because this tool takes no colour reference image — the
palette-forcing that fixed the pixflux runs does not apply to it.

args.description: 1). open grassland and tilled farmland tile 2). dense woodland canopy tile 3). rolling grassy hills tile 4). bare grey rock and scree tile
